title: PlayerCONSOLE-FREE
description: Control your server using a server panel FROM ANYWHERE!
body:
# 🎮 PlayerCONSOLE FREE

**PlayerCONSOLE FREE** is a lightweight web-based management console for Bukkit / Spigot / Paper servers.
Access your server dashboard directly from any browser after installation.

---

# ✅ Features

## 🖥️ Dashboard

* Live player list with health, hunger, and level
* Quick-kick and quick-ban buttons
* Saved quick-action commands
* Kick / ban / mute / unban command panel
* Live chat viewer and broadcaster
* Full server console with command input

---

## 📦 Plugin Manager

* Drag-and-drop `.jar` uploads
* View installed plugins
* Enabled/disabled status display
* Delete plugins from the browser
* Remote server restart button

---

## ⏰ Scheduler

* Automated repeating tasks
* Run console commands
* Broadcast messages
* Custom intervals
* Enable, disable, instant-run, or delete tasks

---

## 🎨 Themes

* Purple gradient
* Dark mode
* Blue theme
* Custom hex gradients

---

# ⭐ Premium Features

Premium unlocks advanced management tools:

* 📦 Inventory management
* 🏆 Player leaderboards
* 📁 File manager with YAML highlighting
* 📊 TPS & performance graphs
* ❤️ Server health tracking
* 🌍 World management
* ⚙️ Essentials controls
* 📝 `server.properties` editor
* 🖼️ Custom image MOTDs
* 💾 Backup manager
* 🗄️ Database + SQL console
* 🧵 Staff notes & admin chat
* 🛡️ Roles & permissions
* 🔐 Two-factor authentication
* 📜 Activity logs
* 🧩 Expansion marketplace
* ⚡ Velocity proxy support
* 🚀 Setup wizard
* 🔄 Scheduled restarts & conditional tasks

---
